title: WorkoutPlan
description: JSON Schema for AI-generated workout plans importable into Workout Tracker

planName.description: Name of the workout plan (e.g., 'Recovery-Optimized Calisthenics')

goals.description: List of fitness or performance goals

principles.description: Key training principles (e.g., RIR, rest times, deload frequency)

routines.description: Dictionary of routine names mapped to lists of exercises

name.description: Name of exercise, optionally including details or tempo cues

sets.description: Total number of sets for this exercise

targetReps.description: Target rep count or hold duration (e.g., '8-10', '20-30s')

restSeconds.description: Rest duration in seconds after each set

notes.description: Execution notes, intensity targets (e.g., 1 RIR), or warm-up cues
